payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate from right to left, computing dp[i] = a[i] + (dp[i+a[i]] if i+a[i] < n else 0). Return max over dp.
payload.rationale: The solution uses a 1D DP array to store maximum score from each starting index, updating from right to left in O(n). This is classic single-dimensional DP along an array.
